description: Header file defining functions for generating XML test summaries, including functions to open/close tags, write test suite/test case details, and manage summary lifecycle.

methods.name: clar_summary_close_tag
methods.description: Closes an XML tag with proper indentation.

methods.name: clar_summary_testsuite
methods.description: Creates a <testsuite> XML element with metadata.

methods.name: clar_summary_testcase
methods.description: Creates a <testcase> XML element with name, classname, and elapsed time.

methods.name: clar_summary_failure
methods.description: Creates a <failure> XML element with type, message, and description.

methods.name: clar_summary_init
methods.description: Initializes a summary object, opens file for writing.

methods.name: clar_summary_shutdown
methods.description: Finalizes the summary, writes closing tags, and frees resources.
